# Blogs, articles and page templates

A blog is an index page with its articles; an article is a page with its own publish state. Both render through a page template: `template.index` (the `templates` resource) lists the `templateId`s, what each template draws around the page's own tree and which parts it locks.

[`blog.create`](#blogcreate) · [`article.create`](#articlecreate) · [`blog.update`](#blogupdate) · [`article.update`](#articleupdate) · [`article.publish`](#articlepublish) · [`article.unpublish`](#articleunpublish) · [`template.index`](#templateindex) · [`template.read`](#templateread)

## blog.create

Create a blog index page from its `title` (in `locale`), an optional `slug`, optional `slugs` (its slug in each other locale, `{ "en": "notes" }`) and `templateId`, the theme template it renders with (template.index lists the `blog-index` ones and what each draws around the page's own tree); articles go under it with article.create. Answers the new page's id and slug. Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `slugs` | Record<string, string> |  |
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `locale` | string (min 1) |  |

Output: { id: string, slug: string, templateId: string, blogId?: string }

Example input:

```json
{"title":"Journal","templateId":"blog-index-editorial-grid"}
```

## article.create

Create a draft article under a blog index (`blogId`, the blog index page id) from its `title`, an optional `slug`, optional `slugs` (its slug in each other locale, `{ "en": "a-house-on-the-hill" }`) and `templateId`, the article template it renders with (template.index lists the `article` ones), and optionally `publishedAt`, its publication date (ISO, not in the future), which its first article.publish keeps. Its content is its tree: fill it with tree.commit on the answered id; it stays off the public site until article.publish. Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `slugs` | Record<string, string> |  |
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `locale` | string (min 1) |  |
| `blogId` | uuid | yes |
| `publishedAt` | string |  |

Output: { id: string, slug: string, templateId: string, blogId?: string }

Example input:

```json
{"title":"A house on the hill","templateId":"article-gallery-sticky","blogId":"5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f1a-8b2c-3d4e5f6a7b8c"}
```

## blog.update

Patch a blog index page as { id, patch }: its slug, its slug per locale (`slugs`: `{ "en": "notes" }` sets one, `null` removes it; renaming a published page keeps its old address as a 301), title, excerpt, featured image, author, canonical URL, SEO (`seo.metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `ogImageId`, `ogImages` the share image per other locale, `noIndex`), template or members-only access. Its content is its tree. Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `patch` | { slug?: string, slugs?: Record<string, string \| null>, title?: Record<string, string>, excerpt?: Record<string, string> \| null, featuredImageId?: string \| null, authorUserId?: string \| null, authorName?: string \| null, canonicalUrl?: string \| null, seo?: { metaTitle?: Record<string, string> \| null, metaDescription?: R… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { id: string (min 1) }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f1a-8b2c-3d4e5f6a7b8c","patch":{"title":{"en-US":"Journal"}}}
```

## article.update

Patch an article as { id, patch }: its slug, its slug per locale (`slugs`: `{ "en": "my-house" }` sets one, `null` removes it; renaming a published article keeps its old address as a 301), title, excerpt, featured image, author, canonical URL, SEO (`seo.metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `ogImageId`, `ogImages` the share image per other locale, `noIndex`), template or members-only access, and `publishedAt`, its publication date (ISO, not in the future): a draft keeps it for its first article.publish, and a published article moves to it at once, still published and without its other draft edits, its BlogPosting `datePublished`, the sitemap and the lists following. Its content is its tree. Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `patch` | { slug?: string, slugs?: Record<string, string \| null>, title?: Record<string, string>, excerpt?: Record<string, string> \| null, featuredImageId?: string \| null, authorUserId?: string \| null, authorName?: string \| null, canonicalUrl?: string \| null, seo?: { metaTitle?: Record<string, string> \| null, metaDescription?: R… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { id: string (min 1) }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b","patch":{"title":{"en-US":"A house on the hill"},"excerpt":{"en-US":"Notes from the site."}}}
```

## article.publish

Put an article and its current content on the public site on their own, at once, without a site publish: its status becomes published and, when it has none yet, its publication date is now (a date set with article.create or article.update stays). Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["publish"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { ok: true }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"}
```

## article.unpublish

Take an article off the public site at once: it becomes a draft again and keeps its first publication date for a later article.publish. Entry validation (page type, template, slug) and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["publish"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { ok: true }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"}
```

## template.index

List the page templates of the site's theme: the `templateId` blog.create, article.create, blog.update and article.update take. Each with its id, label, the page type it serves (`appliesTo`), its layout frame, whether the site forked it (`source`, `forkPageId`), how many pages use it and its top-level parts: the outlet the page's own tree fills and the locked parts the template draws on every page of it, with the fields they bind (`page.title`, `item.featuredImageId`), the list they repeat and the props it sets on its components. `configure` says how to change each kind of part. Read one template's outline with template.read.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { theme: string, templates: ({ id: string, label: string, appliesTo: "static" \| "blog-index" \| "article", layout: string, source: "theme" \| "site", forkPageId?: string, pages: integer ≥0, parts: ({ node: string, name?: string, role: "outlet" \| "locked", binds?: …[], feed?: { kind: "articles", … } \| { kind: "collection"… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## template.read

Read one page template by its id: its summary as template.index lists it and the outline of the tree that draws its pages (the site's fork once it has one), one line per node with its id, type and name. Refused with 404 template_not_found, naming the valid ids, for an id template.index does not list.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { template: { id: string, label: string, appliesTo: "static" \| "blog-index" \| "article", layout: string, source: "theme" \| "site", forkPageId?: string, pages: integer ≥0, parts: ({ node: string, name?: string, role: "outlet" \| "locked", binds?: string[], feed?: { kind: …, blog: …, limit: … } \| { kind: …, collection: …,… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"blog-index-editorial-grid"}
```
